title: So I'm Not Crazy?
content: I've (31f) had vivid, looooong, elaborate dreams my entire life, and since I'm blessed with intense Chronic Fatigue, I can easily sleep 12-19 hours in one go. So my dreams are pretty uninterrupted and I spend a lot of time either exploring or trapped, depending on the vibe and location. I'm so glad to discover others like me, that find themselves back in the same places over and over again. If I had any artistic ability, I could easily draw detailed maps and pictures of my most frequent three. They're where I've been for the past couple decades or so: —Middle/High School/College Campus -Usual scenario is that I have somehow returned and I have no access to my schedule, but class is starting soon and I need to figure out where I'm supposed to be. Or I have started the semester and need to move into the dorms, but can't find anyone to let me into an empty room. Endless hallways and staircases that lead to nowhere. No one is helpful to talk to. Lots of students and teachers but legitimately no answers to questions. —Huge Bathroom -Hundreds or thousands of stalls. All of either dirty, clogged, flooded, have no walls, or are weird and unusable shapes. Some have showers running in them making them impossible to use without getting wet. Dark, gray, grungy bathrooms usually. Never any privacy. Usually full of people. —Mansion Under Construction/Renovation -Sense that I lived there once. Feels like home is being torn apart. Don't actually recognize it at all. The only people there are viewing the house to buy, and can't see me. I feel like I want to protect it from them. I resent them for taking/changing it. Secret passageways. Mostly just drywall and the frames of the house. Pretty skeletal.
